title: CRS-aware area + great-circle distance
query: What is the area of Champaign County, Illinois, in square kilometres? And what is the great-circle distance in km between Trafalgar Square, London (51.5080 N, 0.1281 W) and Notre-Dame de Paris (48.8530 N, 2.3499 E)?

expected_why.distance_km: pyproj Geod(WGS84).inv; a spherical haversine is within 0.3%

answer:
**1. Area of Champaign County, Illinois**  
The area of Champaign County, Illinois, is **2,586.01 km²** (approximately 2,586 km², or about 998 square miles). This was computed from the US Census TIGER/Line boundary (GEOID 17019), reprojected to the equal-area Albers projection (EPSG:5070) for accuracy.

**2. Great-circle distance between Trafalgar Square and Notre-Dame de Paris**  
The great-circle distance is **343.89 km** (approximately 344 km). This was calculated using the haversine formula with Earth's radius of 6,371 km, from Trafalgar Square (51.5080° N, 0.1281° W) to Notre-Dame de Paris (48.8530° N, 2.3499° E).

The Champaign County boundary was also placed on your interactive map as a layer, with a downloadable GeoJSON file available at: `/agent/files/file_1e0e651a9998/download`.
